handoff: For T13: its row is already in the INTERACTIONS table of site/tests/e2e/engine-fallback.spec.ts (load so(3,5) from the D4 catalogue, runs 'main'), so T13 needs nothing more. For T14 and later tools whose reader action makes an engineCall: add one object to INTERACTIONS with name, path (route plus query, relative to baseURL), runs ('main' if whereToRun keeps the action on the main thread, otherwise 'worker'), an optional timeout, and act(page). act waits for data-hydrated (and the first draw if there is one), drives the action, then checks a data-out result. The test itself fails on any engineAll request; a 'main' row also fails on any worker request, and a 'worker' row fails if there is none. For the scan: call engineCall with the name in quotes, or with a value whose type is a union of names. Only pass engineCall on with a type whose first parameter is such a union (as t13/load.ts does with Caller). Provide every one of those names in the same file with provide({ ... }) taking an object literal.
